title: pouteria dolichosperma
intro: Pouteria dolichosperma, commonly known as the Yellow Poui, is a plant species native to the tropical forests of Brazil. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, as well as being used to treat skin conditions and infections. The therapeutic actions of Pouteria dolichosperma include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and demonstrate potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
